integrity: Original algebraic and dynamical proof with exact symbolic supplementary checks and optional finite numerical trajectories; no claim of independent certification or complete historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Only exact critical finite deterministic irreducible network SIRS; no stochastic or off-critical conclusions; logarithmic residual controlled to o(log t), not to O(1); sign reversal demonstrated for a specified irreducible two-node family, not universally across networks.
title: Critical network SIRS extinction: a universal logarithmic law with a sharp waning-rate sign reversal
